admission_requirements: same taxon/population or tightly matched biological architecture
signed entry phase measured before perturbation
historical feedback reliance estimated independently of perturbed downstream outcome
effective opportunity loss independently defined before downstream timing outcome
post-perturbation final phase error/variance on the same coordinate
selection/observation reweighting measured, controlled, or avoided with repeated-individual design

passes: individual IDs and repeated encounter histories

screened_systems.system: Peng et al. 2023 great knot / Yellow Sea

decision.rule: do not replace the missing within-system perturbation with cross-taxon regressions or raw before/after population variance

next_preferred_design: repeated-individual before/after natural experiment with independently quantified usable opportunity loss, pre-perturbation feedback architecture, same-coordinate final phase, and explicit survival/observation tracking
